source: Network and stations: MTR open data mtr_lines_and_stations.csv via HK Bus Crawling@2021. Fares: MTR open data mtr_lines_fares.csv and airport_express_fares.csv (adult Octopus), downloaded from opendata.mtr.com.hk.
note: fares["A>B"] with codes in alphabetical order = adult Octopus fare in HKD. Domestic network from mtr_lines_fares.csv; Airport Express from airport_express_fares.csv. single["A>B"] = adult SINGLE JOURNEY TICKET fare in HKD, same key shape — what somebody without an Octopus actually pays, median 9.7% and up to 25% more.
